title: Higher Cotorsion Pairs on Image-Nilpotent \(η\)-Extensions
summary: Let \(\cB\) be an abelian category with enough projective and injective objects, and let $ \cA=\cB\ltimes_η\sF $ be an \(η\)-extension induced by a right exact endofunctor \(\sF\). We introduce uniform image-nilpotence for \(η\)-extensions and characterize it in terms of the nilpotence of the associative natural transformation \(η:\sF^2\to\sF\). Using the associated \(η\)-Loewy filtration, we prove a lifting theorem for right \(n\)-cotorsion pairs over image-nilpotent \(η\)-extensions and establish a corresponding completeness theorem.
